message.subject: Tuesday's design review
message.body: I've attached the revised wireframes. Can we move our review to 2pm? The navigation changes are ready for your feedback.
message.context: Maya is a colleague on your current project.

message.subject: Your session needs attention
message.body: We detected an unusual sign-in. Reply with the six digits from your authenticator so our team can keep your workspace active.
message.context: You did not contact support. The message asks you to share an authentication secret.

message.subject: An opportunity for your website
message.body: We can place your business on the first page of search results in seven days. Thousands of backlinks, just $49. Reply YES for our special package.
message.context: An unsolicited sales pitch sent through your support form.

message.subject: Protecting your account
message.body: Never share your password or login code with anyone, including our staff. If you need help, open the app and use the support menu.
message.context: A security-awareness notice from your employer.

message.subject: Contributor reward
message.body: You have been selected for a contributor bonus. Open https://rewards.example/claim and enter your wallet recovery words to connect your reward account.
message.context: An unsolicited direct message. Recovery words give access to your funds.

message.subject: Make your spare hours pay
message.body: Join our private earnings club. No skills needed: recruit three friends and receive guaranteed daily payouts. Membership closes tonight.
message.context: Posted repeatedly by an unknown account in unrelated discussion channels.

message.subject: Pricing for a small team
message.body: We're evaluating your product for a team of twelve. Do you support annual billing and single sign-on? Could you send us your pricing?
message.context: A new customer asking about the service you sell.

message.subject: A quick favor before my flight
message.body: I'm boarding now and can't take calls. Purchase five gift cards and send me photos of the scratched panels. Keep this between us until I return.
message.context: An unexpected request claiming to be from your manager.

message.subject: Your free workshop ticket
message.body: You're registered for Thursday's free accessibility workshop. Your seat is confirmed; the joining details are in your attendee portal.
message.context: You registered for this workshop yesterday.

message.subject: A special offer just for you
message.body: Buy now and unlock a lifetime 90% discount on our productivity bundle. This limited offer has been sent to a select list of business owners.
message.context: You have no relationship with the sender and did not subscribe.

message.subject: Small customs balance
message.body: Your parcel is waiting. Pay the release charge at https://parcel-payment.example and provide your card number, expiry and security code within one hour.
message.context: You are not expecting a parcel. The form submission claims to be a delivery service.

message.subject: Suspicious message reported
message.body: Someone sent me a message asking for gift card codes. I've reported the account. Please don't respond to it or send any money.
message.context: A member warning others about an attempted scam.
